_description: Known HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities pending major framework upgrades. Each entry must have a tracked remediation and a target_date. Review monthly and remove entries as they are fixed. Adding an entry here means committing to a remediation plan — it is NOT a permanent exemption.

_sla.high: 30 days from discovery; entries here have an approved extension

entries.advisory: GHSA braces — stack-exhaustion DoS via deeply nested patterns (transitive via jest v29 → micromatch → braces)
entries.scope: devDependencies only — does NOT affect production runtime
entries.reason: jest v29 is used as the test framework for the NestJS backend. The vulnerable package (braces) is a transitive devDependency. It is not reachable from production code or the deployed API. Fix requires upgrading jest v29 → v30, which is a major breaking change requiring coordinated test migration (runner API changes, expect API changes, snapshot format changes).
entries.remediation: Upgrade jest to v30 and migrate all test files (runner API, expect API, snapshot format). Estimated effort: ~2 days. Coordinate with the full backend test suite (API unit + integration + contract tests).
